summary: Invoice line for retired VPC egress connector and missing prorated credit
description:
Issue summary:
Customer AtlasAI received invoice #INV-2026-0310 with a charge for a private VPC egress connector that was retired mid-billing-cycle (connector id: vpc-conn-78-retired). AtlasAI requested a prorated credit for the portion of the cycle after retirement.

Impact:
- AtlasAI was charged €1,240.00 for VPC egress hours spanning 2026-02-25 to 2026-03-01 even though the connector was removed on 2026-02-27.
- No prorated credit line appears on the invoice; the customer reports their payment auto‑charged and requests correction before month-end accounting.

Environment:
- Customer private deployment (VPC) with Private control plane and on-prem connector routing through eu-west-1.
- Billing backend: postback-reconciler v3.7.1; invoicing service v2.12.

Steps to reproduce / observed flow:
1) Customer retired the connector via Console on 2026-02-27 09:12 CET (console activity id: act-20260227-901).
2) Post-rotation traffic was routed to hosted fallback for 02/27–03/01 because a cached mapping still referenced the retired connector id.
3) Metering postbacks for the retired connector arrived with tag connector_id=vpc-conn-78-retired on 2026-02-27 09:14–23:59 and 2026-02-28–03-01 from fallback nodes; reconciler accepted them and attributed to AtlasAI private-eject tariff.
4) Invoice generated on 2026-03-10 included the full daily egress lines for 02/27–03/01 with no prorate or credit.

Expected behavior:
- Connector retirement should trigger (a) immediate update to the postback mapping table and (b) postbacks coming from fallback nodes referencing retired IDs should be reclassified to hosted-fallback tariff and to a provisional billing code that is excluded from final private-eject lines, or else generate a prorated credit.

Actual behavior:
- Postback reconciler accepted retired connector-tagged postbacks as private-eject and created invoice lines without prorate. No automatic credit job was triggered.

Logs / evidence attached in ticket body:
- Console activity id: act-20260227-901 (customer supplied).
- Sample reconciler acceptance events: reconciler.log lines with trace ids rcz-89a1, rcz-89a2 (2026-02-27 09:14–09:18 CET).
- Invoice excerpt: INV-2026-0310 lines 12–14 (private-vpc egress charges).
- Slack thread: #support -> thread t: slack.com/archives/C0123456/p167762 (customer message included).

Immediate customer ask:
- Apply a manual prorated credit for the amount charged after 2026-02-27 09:12 CET and update the finalized invoice or issue a one-time credit memo. Customer requires confirmation before 2026-03-16 for their internal close.

Investigation notes (support):
- Billing ops ran a dry reconcile and found reconciler mapping table still had a live mapping entry for vpc-conn-78 until 2026-02-27 09:20 due to delayed cache invalidation (cache flush job failed and retried).
- Postback payloads from fallback proxies included connector_id but also older tag format connector.name; reconciler v3.7.1 prefers connector.name when present and fell back to connector_id in a path that does not trigger retirement rules.
- Related PR created to add a retired-connector guard in reconciler: https://github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/pull/4123 (merged, awaiting rollout).
- Potential root cause: cache invalidation race plus a reconciler matching priority regression introduced in v3.7.0 that allowed retired connector_id matches to persist.

Proposed next steps:
- Short-term: issue manual credit memo equal to prorated egress amount for 2026-02-27 09:12 CET -> 2026-03-01 end-of-day and notify customer. (Billing ops assigned to do this).
- Mid-term: deploy reconciler patch that rejects postbacks for retired connector_ids or classifies them under provisional-hosted tariff, and add an alert for cache-flush failures. (Engineering).
- Postmortem: document the cache invalidation behavior and update Console retirement flow to force synchronous reconciler mapping update for private connectors.

Status: engineering patch merged to main; staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-14; manual credit prepared and pending finance approval.

resolution_notes: Manual credit memo drafted for €762.00 and linked to FIN-2026-1187. Reconciler fix merged (PR #4123) to prevent retired-connector acceptance; staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-14. Follow-up action: after staging verification, run backfill to identify any other retired-connector postbacks in the last 30 days and issue credits where appropriate. Customer will receive confirmation and updated invoice once finance finalizes the memo.
